text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while relaxing in my room, I
receive an
email from Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, all trainers! I will soon make
an
announcement with significant
implications for
your future."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Be sure not to miss it! From Tracen
Academy
Director Akikawa."

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! Members of the press, thank
you all
for coming! Listen well! I have
gathered you here
today for an
important announ—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Um, Director! You have to stand on the
box, or
they won't be able to see you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hm, right you are! Apologies, apologies!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
All right, this seems okay. Well, then,
from the
top!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen well! I, the director of Tracen
Academy,
hereby announce...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The establishment of a new race, the
URA Finale!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Murmur, murmur, murmur...

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
"The URA Finale"?! They're creating an
entirely
new race?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa! I'm Otonashi of
Twinkle
Monthly. May I ask you a
question?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Permissible! What is it, Miss Otonashi?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now then...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Can you give us some insight into the
thought
process behind this decision?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Excellent question! I'm glad you asked!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In short, the URA Finale is an event that
allows
every Umamusume to seek a
chance at glory!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
It will be an event where any and all
Umamusume
can compete! Respect!
Honor! Recognition! It will
all be theirs
for the taking!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: A chance at glory... for all Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, hehehe... Hehehehehe!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Now this is getting interesting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sudden announcement of the URA
Finale
rocks the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Immediately afterward, an information
session is
held for everyone at Tracen
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By the time I make it to the gymnasium,
it's
already buzzing with trainers and
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
"The URA Finale," huh... Can they really
just make
up a whole new race like that?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder... I know the director's a big
deal, but
she's still a child at the end of
the day.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
The old director ran the academy like
clockwork,
but that doesn't mean her
daughter knows what
she's—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Excuse me for interrupting.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There will be time for questions after the

director's address. If you have any
concerns, you
may bring them up then.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Tazuna! E-excuse us! We didn't
mean to be
rude!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the mood in the room,
there's still a
lot of confusion and
uncertainty.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere persists as Director
Akikawa's
URA Finale briefing session
finally begins.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! I'm sure that many of you
must have
been taken aback by this
sudden announcement.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However! I ask that you hear me out as I
explain
the significance of the URA
Finale!

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text: Significance? What does she mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd glances at one another, and a
hum of
whispers fills the hall. With
perfect timing,
Director Akikawa
resumes her address.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: My beloved students and trainers!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Tell me, have you ever known regret?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to win the Arima Kinen!" "I want
to
conquer the Derby!" "I want to be the
strongest
Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever had dreams that you
couldn't
realize because the distance or
the track surface
just wasn't right for
you?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever ground your teeth in
chagrin as
you thought, "I'm better than
this!"?! Trainers,
have you not had similar
regrets?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heed me! I aim to create a world where
all
Umamusume who aspire to race can
shine!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And Umamusume runners shine the
brightest
when their wills clash! As they
battle it out for the
top spot, the heat of
battle shall forge and polish
our racers
until their brilliance is blinding!
Blinding,
I say!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In summary! I wish to prepare a race that
will
serve as a stage for all Umamusume
to show their
full potential!

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text: Director...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Currently, each G1 race has a
designated
distance and track type,
limiting the runners who
can join that
particular race.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Behold! The URA Finale will feature all
distances
and tracks!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All distances!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All tracks?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Just like in the Arima Kinen and the
Takarazuka
Kinen, participating racers
will be selected by fan
vote!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Ergo, only Umamusume who have won
many fans
through their performance in
the Twinkle
Series—the star
Umamusume—may take part!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Racers! I ask of you! Will you take this
chance to
show your true strength?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Will you aim for the top and seize the
title of
Finale Champion?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainers! I ask of you! Will you take this
chance to
push your trainees to their
limits?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Will you see your trainee crowned the
first-ever
winner of the URA Finale?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Three years from now, in the new year,
you will
have your chance! Come! Gather
your fans and
become superstars!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Excitement! I look
forward to
your success!

text_block_list.name: Attendees
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere in the gymnasium shifts

completely as the doubts previously
held by the
audience melt away and are
replaced with
raucous applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the birth of a new
year-end race,
the URA Finale, is
announced!
